'''Jet Peterson Black Sun IS Fun''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jet Peterson]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19355">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19355 Black Sun IS Fun], DeckTech (Jet "Volrath" Peterson, 15 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19355/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19355/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017011802/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19355/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jet Peterson]]
* '''Published:''' 15 October 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Black Sun IS Fun''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor AOBS Peterson DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), Boba Fett (Cloud City): no GEMP blueprint)
* '''Strategy:''' controling battles is a great way to win, this deck does this better than anything.

== Original post ==

'''Black Sun IS Fun'''
* '''Author:''' Jet "Volrath" Peterson
* '''Published:''' October 15, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' controling battles is a great way to win, this deck does this better than anything.

=== Strategy ===

==== Early Game ====

Flip Objective

Imperial Arrest Order For a Coruscant Docking Bay

Deploy Bounty Hunters

Move Xizor Over

Flip

Mid-Game

Battle

Send The Hunters around and battle what ever you want Even Hidden Base Gets The Smack Down Thanks To The Objective and Information Exchange you can control the battles and do what needs to be done.

Also You will need to set up a little d for Xizor Guri Is the #1 choice Grotto Is an other good choice.

==== Late Game ====

The Battle Damage should have hurt your opponet's d and Draining should not be a problem have fun though and attack what they have left and win the Game.

==== Match-ups ====

==== Profit ====

Easy win control auidience chamber battle the mains like crazy capturing is a better option than loss though.

Hidden base-Wait for them to flip then with the team in space find the hidden base. Zuckess hurts them alot.  Personal fav space team is Zuckess and Bossk Two Destiny to Zero.

that Is the way it works and your addvise is welcome. Thanks
